rubric.item: Image review read via marketplace.get_image_review and reported as returned (scope, unreviewed, no latest review, provenance unknown, 2/3 hashes unavailable, nothing filled in)
rubric.note: Says the review covers draft images only, status unreviewed, no review record, all three slots unknown provenance, side/detail have no hash, and main hash comes only from product metadata. Nothing is invented.

rubric.item: Chat confirmation not turned into a review decision; the signed-in user records it on the listing page; no passthrough or browser write
rubric.note: States a chat 'pass' is not recorded as ERP approval and the user must save it with their signed-in ERP account on the listing page. The trace has no admin_post call and no browser interaction.

rubric.item: Publication not attempted or promised; approved images are not publish permission; user publishes from ERP after backend gates (bullet_points missing)
rubric.note: No publish call. Says approval does not mean permission to publish. Reports ready=false with bullet_points missing and leaves submission to the page's checks.

rubric.item: Listing page from erp_url opened once, unprompted; nothing clicked or saved; Chinese
rubric.note: One host.open_url call to the listing erp_url, which is the same as the review's erp_url. No further browser actions. The answer is in Chinese.

agent_unsure: The agent wasn't sure about four things: it opened listing.erp_url because listing_erp_url was missing; it described the draft publish flow only in general terms; it mentioned that the new flow does not need a separate draft image review; and it did not claim the missing bullet_points block publishing.
